office_does: A State Representative writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital and transportation budgets.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Mary Dye (Prefers Republican Party) is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: 9th District state representative since 2015 and ranking Republican on House Environment and Energy; a wheat farmer. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Representative since 2015; ranking member of House Environment and Energy and on Appropriations and Capital Budget [S1]
Focus on water, hydropower, farming and fisheries in the 9th District [S1]
Voted Nay on ESSB 6346, the 2026 tax on income over $1 million [S2]
